contexts.text: The river, here, the river of Egypt, or the Nile, = a boundary... for the great rivers, namely, the Euphrates, Jordan, and Nile... were ultimate boundaries of the Land of Canaan... The Nile, or river of Egypt, represented the sensuous things subject to the intellectual part, thus the scientifics which are from them; for these are the ultimates of the spiritual things of the Lord's Kingdom.
The waters of the river, namely, of the Nile, = false Scientifics.
The harvest of the Nile () = good thence (that is, from scientific truth) outside the Church.
That the river of Egypt, the Nile... was a boundary of Canaan. Illustrated.
The river Nile = the false Scientific.

The river of Egypt, or Nile (as one of the boundaries of Canaan, and as being outside Canaan) signified such things as are of the natural man... It signified a termination of the Church, and also introduction into the Church. Moreover, the cognitions and scientifics which are signified by the river of Egypt, introduce...
The Scientific which is of the natural man is signified by the river of Egypt, the Nile...
